section_1_permitted_uses.description: OBELISK may only use PHI as necessary to provide AI governance services
permitted_purposes: Encryption key management for PHI at rest and in transit
Access control enforcement for AI agents processing PHI
Audit logging of all PHI access events

administrative_safeguards.security_training: Annual HIPAA training + quarterly security updates
administrative_safeguards.contingency_plan: Disaster recovery with 4-hour RTO, encrypted backups

technical_safeguards.audit_controls: Immutable audit logs with blockchain anchoring
technical_safeguards.integrity: SHA-256 checksums on all PHI, tamper detection
technical_safeguards.encryption: AES-256-GCM (HSM-backed keys), key rotation every 90 days

obelisk_guarantees.prompt_injection_defense: Multi-layer prompt injection detection blocks 99.7% of attempts
obelisk_guarantees.destruction_procedure: Cryptographic erasure (key destruction) upon agreement termination
